title: DuwatBench: Bridging Language and Visual Heritage through an Arabic Calligraphy Benchmark for Multimodal Understanding
findings: Models struggled to recognize text in ornate calligraphic styles like Thuluth and Diwani, which are often used for religious inscriptions. There was a tendency for models to overpredict common religious terms like 'Allah' or to expand recognized religious phrases (e.g., 'Bismillah') into longer, more common forms (e.g., 'Bismillah Ar Rahman Ar Rahim'), indicating that cultural and religious priors learned during training influenced their predictions on visually ambiguous inputs.
